title: Shortest detection in the lane
body:
His summary: 'three corners closed themselves. I counted to three.' The demo replays it.

His principle, triangle edition: 'three corners closed themselves. I counted to three. Shortest detection in the lane.'
nine_numbers: JAH's notebook: 'the triangle finder is the corner finder with a number attached. Three. Same kernels, same Harris, one question: how many corners? The nine numbers did the seeing; I do the counting.'
shape_recipe: JAH's recipe: 'Harris loud, take three, count to three, walk home. If you end where you started, the edges made a triangle. Shortest recipe in the lane.'
knowing_when: JAH's knowing-when: 'three and only three. The strict threshold is there because diagonal staircases whisper fake corners — fifty percent of max shuts them up.'
